name: Amortized Straw Man
subtitle: who needs a brain with all this money?
rules: This card enters play with 3 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- INSTALLMENT PLAN -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from this card.
flavor: We need to affect a proactive paradigm shift by way of ubiquitous partnerships with channel suppliers and forward-thinking opinion leaders in the equity growth vertical.
notes: No artist credit in footer. 1st Edition badge.

name: Armored Keep
subtitle: protected store of gold, jewels, and catnip
rules: UNIQUE ARMORED KEEP -- You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. -- You do not lose the game while your faction has 0 influence.
notes: Catalog uses TACTICAL keyword for 'You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic' and 'because' for 'while'. No artist credit.

name: Beatrix Winterbottom
subtitle: aggressive and dominant closer of deals
rules: UNIQUE BEATRIX -- If you draw any number of cards, increase the amount by 1. -- While you have at least 10 cards in your hand, if you would draw a card instead you don't draw that card.
flavor: She doesn't care about you, she's just looking at your assets.
notes: Catalog templating: 'When you draw' for 'If you draw'; 'you cannot draw cards' for 'if you would draw a card instead you don't draw that card'. No artist credit.

name: Blanching Butcher
subtitle: you got served
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 3 influence. -- If this card blocks, it gains 4 strength and 4 life this turn.
flavor: "Waiter! Where's my soup!?"
notes: Catalog says 'When this card blocks' for 'If this card blocks'. No artist credit.

name: Brummagem Jewelry
subtitle: i pity the fool who don't like my jewelry
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- When this card enters play, deplete the attached character. -- The attached character cannot be restored by its faction's RESTORE RULE.
notes: Catalog says 'its controller's faction's Restore Rule' for 'its faction's RESTORE RULE'. No artist credit.

name: Cash Out
subtitle: the best investment he ever made
rules: COST – Pick a number for X. Pay twice X. (X can be 0.) -- EFFECT – Draw X+1 cards.
flavor: In case of emergency, sell wife.
notes: Catalog: 'Choose a number for X. Pay X+X.' for 'Pick a number for X. Pay twice X. (X can be 0.)'. No artist credit.

name: Concealed Goon
subtitle: he blends right in
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, your faction loses 5 influence.
flavor: Sure is lucky there aren't any goons around. Yep, no goons here. I mean, it would really suck if a goon turned up. That would ruin everything. But, um... yeah. No goons.
notes: No artist credit.

name: Dandy Day-Trader
subtitle: trafficker of metaphysical currency
flavor: Mortimer made a fortune investing in the gravity IPO. Unfortunately, he lost it all on a rainy day due to a massive overextension in the sunlight market.
notes: Vanilla; no rules text. No artist credit.

name: Defense Attorney
subtitle: impassioned advocate for hire
rules: If you are attacked and this card could block, this card must block.
flavor: "Clearly my client is the victim here!"
notes: Catalog templating: 'When you are attacked, this card must block if it can.' No artist credit.

name: Downsizing
subtitle: look busy or you could be next
rules: Destroy all characters. Your opponent's faction gains X influence, where X is the number of characters destroyed.
flavor: "The terms of our severance package ensure a high rate of employee retention."
notes: Catalog: 'Each opponent's faction ... destroyed this way' for 'Your opponent's faction ... destroyed'. No artist credit.

name: Erotic Assassin
subtitle: violent and voluptuous
rules: This card cannot be restored by your faction's RESTORE RULE. -- This card can attack only once each turn. -- RESTORE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Restore this card.
flavor: "Now there's a wave of destruction that's easy on the eyes."
notes: No artist credit.

name: Executive Poaching
subtitle: get 'em? that was your plan?
rules: Destroy the character your opponent controls with the highest numeric cost. If there is a tie, you decide which character is destroyed.
flavor: "He's putting for eagle...this is for the entire tournament...Oh! He was stolen by a necromorph! That's got to be disappointing!"
notes: Catalog says 'an opponent controls' for 'your opponent controls'. No artist credit.

name: Free Trade Agreement
subtitle: favors all, and none
rules: At the start of each player's turn, that player must pick one of the following: -- OPTION 1 – That player may draw a card and their opponent may play a resource. -- OPTION 2 – That player may play a resource and their opponent may draw a card. -- OPTION 3 – Both players may draw up to 2 cards. -- OPTION 4 – Both players may play up to 2 resources.
notes: Catalog uses multiplayer templating (chooses / opponents / Each player) for printed 'must pick / their opponent / Both players'. No artist credit.

name: Ghostly Auditor
subtitle: balancing your books from beyond the grave
rules: While you control only 1 character, this card gains COVERT. -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, draw 2 cards.
flavor: "You forgot to file form 37-Ohhhhh..."
notes: Catalog says 'When this card inflicts damage' for 'If this card inflicts damage'. No artist credit.

name: Gold Summit
subtitle: who's your daddy?
rules: If you draw a card, your faction gains 1 influence.
flavor: Randolph von Macavowitz Spitoon III, Ltd. always enjoys showing his money who's boss.
notes: Printed per-card trigger ('If you draw a card, ... gains 1 influence'); catalog restates as 'When you draw any number of cards, ... gains X influence, where X is the number of cards drawn' (same total). No artist credit.

name: Greed
notes: Card is printed rotated 90 degrees. Faction BANKER at left, STAPLE RESOURCE bar, name GREED. 'STAPLE' is printed in the rarity slot; no collector number, no artist credit. No rules text.

name: Index of Natural Forces
subtitle: trading ground of would-be gods
rules: CAPITALIZE -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: Mau invest not only in property and jewels; they maintain interests in the fabric of reality itself.
notes: No artist credit.

name: Intermittently Sneaky Lawyer
subtitle: a little on the nose, don't you think?
rules: While you have at least 6 cards in your hand, this card gains 1 strength and COVERT.
flavor: "We need a symbol. Something that says we're sneaky and a lawyer."
notes: No artist credit.

name: Irresistible Bribe
subtitle: dissecting moral code with diamond-like precision
rules: COST – Pick a character. X is that character's strength. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character. Your opponent's faction gains X influence.
flavor: Drugging the audience? Three month's salary. Bumping off last year's winner? A small fortune. Buying the judge? A king's ransom. The smile on my little girl's face? Priceless.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent's faction gains X influence'; catalog says 'That character's controller's faction gains X influence' (differs when the picked character is your own). No artist credit.

name: Limited Liability
subtitle: in the finest print money can buy
rules: This turn, no damage can be inflicted and no cards can be destroyed. This does not affect paying costs; if a cost requires you to destroy a card, it is still destroyed.
flavor: "Alright, already. There's one for each arm, one for the head and one for the leg. But if you want a new shoehorn you'll have to buy it yourself. What do I look like? The charity department?"
notes: Card prints 'no damage can be inflicted and no cards can be destroyed' (costs still destroy); catalog says 'cards in play and cards deployed can only be destroyed by costs, and all inflicted damage is reduced to 0'. Probably a later templating, but 'not inflicted' vs 'reduced to 0' can differ for damage triggers, so flagged. No artist credit.

name: Mafia Lawyer
subtitle: you're not innocent until he says so
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 2 influence. -- If this card is destroyed in a battle your faction gains X influence, where X is the total strength of the opposing party.
flavor: "You have the right to an attorney. If you cannot afford an attorney, Vinny and Brick there will break your kneecaps."
notes: Catalog says 'destroyed during a battle' for 'destroyed in a battle'. No artist credit.

name: Magic Vault
subtitle: gradual enhancer of voidal currency
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pick a faction. If you do, that faction gains 2 influence.
flavor: "You see, feedback is the key to our wealth. The vaults are a tremendous expenditure, true, but the interest they generate simply by storing the voidal humour in its materialized state will eventually pay for the investment many times over. Never have the rich gotten richer with less effort."
notes: No artist credit.

name: Mau "Consultant"
subtitle: if you're buying, he's advising
rules: When this card enters play, draw a card and your faction loses 2 influence.
flavor: "My good lad, nothing could be more practical in battle than this marvelous jewel-encrusted dagger. As your trusted advisor and friend, I suggest you immediately buy three."
notes: Catalog splits into two sentences ('draw a card. Your faction loses 2 influence.'); same effects. No artist credit.

name: Mau Tough
subtitle: he'll bill you for the blood you got on his suit
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 4 influence.
flavor: "Well if you really want them dead, I suggest my $PLATINUM DEAL$ which includes a broken neck, two punctured lungs, a shattered hip, and a free disembowling all administered with the most extravagant bludgeons money can buy!"
notes: Flavor prints 'disembowling' (sic). No artist credit.

name: Nasty Butler
subtitle: please wait in the garden, sir
rules: When this card enters play, your faction gains 4 influence.
flavor: "I'm ending this transmission." — L.G.
notes: Flavor attribution '– L.G.' is on the same line as the quote. No artist credit.

name: Necromorph Bureaucrat
subtitle: can't I just speak to a live person?
rules: SUBJUGATE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick 2 or fewer characters. -- EFFECT – Deplete the characters.
notes: No flavor text. No artist credit.

name: Paralegal Prodigy
subtitle: almost ready for the big time
rules: All your other "lawyer" characters gain 1 strength and 1 life.
flavor: "Your Honor, I move for a full dismissal on the basis that the plaintiff is a doody head!"
notes: Card puts "lawyer" in quotes; catalog drops the quotes. No artist credit.

name: Pervasive Bodyguard
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Steve Bentley
rules: PROTECT -- COST – Pay 1. Pick a character in a party with this card. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 1 life.
flavor: One of Steve's weird-ass "vacation" snaps.
notes: Artist Series card: grayscale photo-style artwork, 'Artist Series' watermark in text box and 'ARTIST SERIES' label in footer. Artist credited only in subtitle (Steve Bentley), not as a footer credit.

name: Pettifogger
subtitle: "and furthermore..."
rules: If this card blocks, destroy it and all members of the attacking party.
flavor: "Extended articulation of the mandatory invocation of the relevant amendment for incessant objection of forward motion of trial proceeding ad nauseum etc. etc."
notes: Catalog says 'When this card blocks' for 'If this card blocks'. Type line prints 'lawyer, mau'; catalog subtypes are only 'lawyer'. No artist credit.

name: Postmortem Debenture
subtitle: secured by corporeal collateral
rules: COST – Pick a character in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character into your hand.
flavor: It took Jesse Doverspike 10 years to save the down payment for his funeral. It may take him 100 to pay off the debt.
notes: No artist credit.

name: Pyramid Scheme
subtitle: Meowphistopheles wants you to fail
rules: COST – Flip a coin. If you win, X is 3 otherwise X is 2. -- EFFECT – Draw X cards.
flavor:
A mau always comes out on top.
Yes, I know it's a bad pun. Deal with it.
notes: Flavor is two separate lines. No artist credit.

name: Rate Hike
subtitle: it's only up to 63.2%...cheap!
rules: Your faction gains 2 influence. Draw a card.
flavor: All money belongs to a Mau somewhere, whether the money realizes it or not.
notes: No artist credit.

name: Recapitulating Apparition
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Zi Jian
rules: If this card is put into your discard pile from play, you may pay 1. If you do, put this card into play under your control, depleted.
flavor: "Honestly, Frank, just pay for the damn piano already!"
notes: Catalog: 'When this card is put into your discard pile from play... put it into play under your control. Deplete it.' vs printed 'If ... put this card into play under your control, depleted.' Same effect. Artist Series card: 'Artist Series' watermark in text box and 'ARTIST SERIES' label in footer; artist credited only in subtitle (Zi Jian).

name: Red Tape
subtitle: plentiful and pointless
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 3 strength. Draw a card.
flavor: "Forrrmmmssss..."
notes: No artist credit.

name: Repo Man
subtitle: lackey of predatory lenders
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a location. If you do, destroy that location.
flavor: "Your dog is 17 bowls of kibble overdue on his mortgage."
notes: No artist credit.

name: Resurrection Emporium
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Jack Heng
rules: If a character would be put into your discard pile from anywhere, remove it from the game instead. -- RESURRECT -- COST – Use this only during your turn. Pick a character in your discard pile. Pay 3+X, where X is that character's numeric cost. -- EFFECT – Put the character into play under your control.
notes: Catalog omits 'from anywhere' (implied) and says 'its numeric cost' for 'that character's numeric cost'. Artist Series card: 'Artist Series' watermark in text box and 'ARTIST SERIES' label in footer; artist credited only in subtitle (Jack Heng).

name: Resurrection Technician
subtitle: looks like the soup du jour was him, har har
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a character in your discard pile. If you do, put that character into your hand.
flavor:
"My God! That's the chairman of Empire Impoverishments! Doesn't he realize he'll return as a necromorph?"
"It's what the will says. Pull the lever, Max."
notes: Flavor is two separate quoted lines. No artist credit.

name: Samuel Gristwalter
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Henry Gunawan
rules: UNIQUE SAMUEL -- No damage can be inflicted to your faction.
flavor: Every law has its price and you get what you pay for.
notes: Card prints 'No damage can be inflicted to your faction.'; catalog says 'Reduce all damage inflicted to your faction to 0.' Probably later templating, but prevention vs reduction can matter for damage triggers, so flagged. Artist Series card: watermark in text box and 'ARTIST SERIES' label in footer; artist credited only in subtitle (Henry Gunawan).

name: Secret Handshake
subtitle: its secrecy is exceeded only by its overtness
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 4 life. Draw a card.
notes: No flavor text. No artist credit.

name: Selective Gluttony
subtitle: tell the bakers we're going to need more cake
rules: Draw 10 cards. Discard 9 cards.
flavor: "Only fifteen courses?! Outrage!"
notes: No artist credit.

name: Shocking Reappearance
subtitle: allow me to speak posthumously
rules: COST – Play this only when you are blocking. Pick a character in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character into play under your control. Add the character to the blocking party.
flavor: "Moving on to the subject of our former chairman's unfortunate demise...Great Scott! Our former chairman!"
notes: Catalog: 'Deploy this only while you are being attacked ... as a member of the blocking party' for printed 'Play this only when you are blocking ... Add the character to the blocking party'. Same effect. No artist credit.

name: Skilled Negotiator
subtitle: throw in the mustache and we have a deal
rules: HAGGLE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 2 strength.
notes: No flavor text. No artist credit.

name: Summary Judgment
subtitle: pay your fine to the clerk downstairs
rules: COST – Pick a character your opponent controls. X is that character's strength. -- EFFECT – Your opponent must pick one of the following: destroy the character or you draw X cards.
notes: Catalog: 'That character's controller may destroy the character. If they don't, draw X cards.' vs printed 'Your opponent must pick one of the following: destroy the character or you draw X cards.' Same choice. No flavor text. No artist credit.

name: Tax Attorney
subtitle: ingenious protector of assets
rules: If your faction loses any amount of influence, reduce the amount by 1.
flavor: "What, this? Just some old junk Mr. Padamose purchased on debt and leased back to his holding company for a convertible note secured against funds owed for consultations with his subsidiary's equity partner's offshore capital advisory firm. Minus out the cost of maintenance, depreciation and interest and it's a crushing loss. He's just a poor old Mau with nothing to call his own but liens, liabilities and a spider or two."
notes: Catalog says 'When your faction loses influence' for 'If your faction loses any amount of influence'. No artist credit.

name: The Ministry of Other Smaller Ministries
rules: Your opponent must pay 2 for each attacking party they form.
flavor: "I told you to stop putting your departments on my side of the table!"
notes: Printed 'Your opponent must pay 2 for each attacking party they form'; catalog 'Each opponent must pay 2 to attack' (taken as the same per-attack payment). Name wraps onto two lines, leaving no subtitle line. No artist credit.

name: Union Leader
subtitle: creator of the 7-day weekend
flavor: "Hey! You can't lift that pillow! You need a Union Lifter, and a Union Lifter Assistant, Union Pillow Management, Union Pillow Fluffier..."
notes: Vanilla; no rules text. No artist credit.
